summary: Energy Fuels filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of VAC Group B.V. and Ara VAC TOPCO US LLC from Ara Partners, a deal originally signed June 23, 2026, alongside completion of its ASM scheme acquisition on August 28, 2026. The filing discloses a Merger Agreement Amendment, supplemental VAC and ASM business disclosures, VAC historical financials, and unaudited pro forma combined financials. It also notes the planned departure of Energy Fuels' Chief Legal Officer and EVP, Global Government Relations. No revised price, stake, premium, or closing date is stated; consummation remains subject to customary conditions. Watch for the Item 2.01 closing 8-K and any deal-term changes embedded in the amendment.
